\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) =
\begin{cases}
255 & \text{if } u < p \text{ and } v < s \\
0 & \text{if } u < p \text{ and } v \ge s \\
I(x,y) & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
\qquad
p = 0.05, \quad s = 0.5
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input pixel
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output pixel
- \(u, v\): Uniform random numbers between 0 and 1 for this pixel
- \(p\): Amount, the probability that a pixel becomes noise
- \(s\): Salt share, the probability that a noisy pixel is white

Two uniform random numbers u and v between 0 and 1 are made for each pixel from the seed and the position. If u is below the amount p, the pixel becomes noise: white when v is below the salt share s, black otherwise. All three channels change together.
